durability: Prototype, fixed plan, harness, independent audit/review, immediate ledger and exact initial/final/regression recovery copies are tracked. The first control expected the wrong rejection stage: adding a fourth root member reaches the three-member ceiling before unknown-name admission. Renaming an existing member isolates the intended guard. Exact first source/result/TAP/ledger and complete allocation/absence recovery remain retained; no prototype repair or live run was needed. Both prior ignored retirement qualification JSON and ledger are restored exactly after their new regression copies are retained.
falsification: Stale owner references, absent/malformed/partial/unknown/shared-link state and caller/argument bypasses reject without mutation. Late source/directory replacement rejects before deletion; injected extra members or directory reappearance retain an explicit partial failure. Removing the retention guard permits destruction of a still-pinned inert image, which the later census detects only after bytes are gone. The independent oracle rejects altered cuts, holds, returns, rejection/late-change controls, capacity, mutation and allocation evidence.

first_failure.cause: The unknown-store-member test appended a fourth member. The existing three-member namespace ceiling correctly rejects before the later unknown-name guard, so the harness expected the wrong diagnostic. Replace the known reference-directory name with an unknown name to isolate the intended guard without exceeding the earlier ceiling.

limits: Only explicit inactive stores are reachable. Preparation and runtime retirement do not invoke maintenance; no production cache, compiler, native fixture, original, collector, helper or contention worker runs.

All runtime references remain retention obligations even when their private workspace is absent. Unknown observation variants reject until explicit combined-format/lifetime qualification; absence of a process or an old timestamp never authorizes deletion.

Partial deletion retains exact failed state for a separately owned recovery audit. A cut after the final directory removal may leave completed deletion without a success return; no implicit retry, repair, alternative candidate or reconstruction occurs.

Snapshots and removal checks use cooperative coordination. Actual contention/inheritance, arbitrary noncooperating mutation, crash/power-loss durability, compiler-workspace profiles, authenticated cleanup/transport and observer/native lifetimes remain unqualified.
This closes only inactive publication/runtime retirement/maintenance. Observation/version compatibility remains the next frontier; historical startup/parent qualification and full CI/push stay gated.
rederive: The fixed prospective plan enumerates before/after deletion of C, manifest, executable and empty candidate directory. A separate lstat/readlink/file-hash observer captures the whole store. Python reconstructs exact content keys/manifests, validates the complete historical acquisition record, joins the immediate allocation ledger and verifies that only the expected candidate nodes disappear. It independently reconstructs the full capacity-key set and checks the unchanged retirement suite against the refined coordinator.
